description: Create a shareable Stripe Payment Link: for ONE price pass priceId (price_…) with an optional quantity; for several pass lineItems: [{priceId, quantity}]. Optionally redirect to afterCompletionUrl when paid. allowPromotionCodes:true shows the promotion-code box at checkout — needed for any 'use code X' ad. referenceId and utm return a taggedUrl: put THAT URL in the ad, and get_stripe_payment_link_revenue (groupBy reference) then counts that ad's purchases. Returns the URL. LIVE key: confirm:true after showing the preview. Idempotent on its arguments. Needs Stripe connected (Connectors > Stripe, or connect_connector).

afterCompletionUrl.description: URL the buyer is sent to after paying

allowPromotionCodes.description: show the promotion-code box at checkout

confirm.description: true on a live key, after the user approves the preview

lineItems.description: several prices at once; use instead of priceId

quantity.description: quantity of this price in the link

metadata.description: key/value metadata stored on the payment link

priceId.description: one price — the shorthand for a single line item

referenceId.description: letters, digits, dashes, underscores (up to 200) — tags the returned taggedUrl for one ad; Stripe stores it on each purchase

utm.description: UTM values on the taggedUrl (letters, digits, dashes, underscores, up to 150 each); Stripe passes them to the after-payment redirect only

campaign.description: UTM campaign on the tagged URL; letters, digits, dashes and underscores, up to 150

content.description: UTM content on the tagged URL; letters, digits, dashes and underscores, up to 150

medium.description: UTM medium on the tagged URL; letters, digits, dashes and underscores, up to 150

source.description: UTM source on the tagged URL; letters, digits, dashes and underscores, up to 150

term.description: UTM term on the tagged URL; letters, digits, dashes and underscores, up to 150

name: create_stripe_payment_link
title: create stripe payment link
